Search engine optimization (SEO)

How Does SEO Work?

SEO was born because of Google and other search engines. All of these search engines send out crawlers or “bots” on every webpage on a frequent basis and figures what are good sites and what are bad sites. From there, it evaluates all the content, triggers, and some magic to understand what web page to show. Finally, Google looks at how people interact with webpages. If a webpage gets clicked more and people spend more time on the site with a specific search, then that webpage will rise to the top.

All of this is why SEO matters.  We focus on a set of 5 large areas to help you grow your business that include

  • On-Site Optimization
  • Off-Site Optimization
  • Measure, Enhance, Repeat
  • Google My Business Management
